I don't have any notes on Psalm 125 to give you yet. My research tools stopped working before I could open a single page. My first attempt to load the commentaries in one batch went over the tool's usage limit, and when I tried loading them one at a time, I was told I had no tool calls left for this turn.

You asked me to report only what the pages actually say, with a URL for each point. Since I haven't read anything, I won't write notes from memory and attach links I haven't checked.

These are the pages I was going to read:

- **Traditional verse-by-verse:**
  - enduringword.com/bible-commentary/psalm-125/
  - biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/psalms/125.htm
  - biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/psalms/125.htm
  - biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/psalms/125.htm
  - biblehub.com/commentaries/barnes/psalms/125.htm
  - preceptaustin.org/psalm-125-commentary
- **Methodist/Wesleyan:** biblehub.com/commentaries/wesley/psalms/125.htm (John Wesley's notes)
- **Baptist:** Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* on Psalm 125 (spurgeon.org or studylight.org)
- **Catholic/early church:** newadvent.org/fathers/1801125.htm (Augustine's sermon on this psalm, which he numbers 125)
- **Modern scholarship:** the netbible.org translator's notes on Psalm 125, especially on v. 3 ("scepter of the wicked") and v. 5 ("crooked ways")

If you send the request again in a new turn, I'll work through these pages one at a time and write the notes verse by verse with their URLs.
